_fare_record.source: No Dubai<->AD ferry. Whole-yacht charter AED 4,500/hr (8-pax ~$95-150/seat); limo AED 250-350. T5/low - opportunity-to-create.
_fare_record.method: Dubai<->AD intercity (59.8nm trunk). No scheduled per-seat sea transfer; E11 road fast/free -> marine premium time/experience product, flight/charter-substituted (R12). Anchored on whole-yacht charter per-seat-equiv + premium intercity transfer.

_demand_record.source: UAE-DEMAND-ANCHORS-2026-06-17.json — sourcing wave: RTA Marine 18M riders 2024; DET 43M room-nights; DCT AD 4.8M hotel visitors; RAKTDA 4.35M guest-nights; Miral Yas 38M visits; Marjan/Skift Wynn projections; SCTDA Sharjah 1.6M.
_demand_record.method: DXB↔AUH ~12-15M road trips/yr (DET 2024 + DCT AD 2024). Premium fast-ferry capture 0.15% high-value biz segment ⇒ 25k oneway/yr. Comparable: Helsinki-Tallinn premium fast-craft scaled down. Sourcing wave 2026-06-17.

_fare_record.source: Dubai-Sharjah Ferry Gold AED 25 subsidized-commuter (R5-EXT). Premium per-seat $85 modeled (between subsidized ferry and charter). T5/low.
_fare_record.method: Dubai->Sharjah (Al Khan) 25.1nm. Operating Dubai-Sharjah Gold ferry (AED 25) is subsidized-commuter with no true premium class (R5-EXT) -> model premium per-seat $85.

_demand_record.source: UAE-DEMAND-ANCHORS-2026-06-17.json — sourcing wave: RTA Marine 18M riders 2024; DET 43M room-nights; DCT AD 4.8M hotel visitors; RAKTDA 4.35M guest-nights; Miral Yas 38M visits; Marjan/Skift Wynn projections; SCTDA Sharjah 1.6M.
_demand_record.method: Sharjah-Dubai = ~250k daily road commuters. Boat capture 0.1% of commuter market (~31k oneway) + 2% of Sharjah's 1.6M hotel guests (SCTDA 2024) for leisure (~16k) ⇒ ~40k oneway/yr. Sourcing wave 2026-06-17.

corridors.to: Wynn Al Marjan Island arrival lagoon

_fare_record.source: Wynn Al Marjan (first UAE gaming resort) opens early 2027: 1,217 rooms + 297 residences. No marine transfer today. T5/low - greenfield.
_fare_record.method: Dubai->Wynn Al Marjan (56nm). INTERCITY, E11 fast/free -> marine premium experience, flight-substituted (R12). Anchored on premium HNW resort-arrival transfer.

_demand_record.source: UAE-DEMAND-ANCHORS-2026-06-17.json — sourcing wave: RTA Marine 18M riders 2024; DET 43M room-nights; DCT AD 4.8M hotel visitors; RAKTDA 4.35M guest-nights; Miral Yas 38M visits; Marjan/Skift Wynn projections; SCTDA Sharjah 1.6M.
_demand_record.method: Wynn Al Marjan (~1,500 keys × 80% occ × 365 × 1.8 guests ≈ 789k guest-nights/yr from 2027). RAKTDA projects 3.8M visitors by 2027. Boat capture 5% of Dubai-origin day-trip flow (1.2M projected) ⇒ 60k oneway/yr. Sourcing wave 2026-06-17.

_fare_record.source: RTA/Dubai-Ferry official ladder (R-RTA, T1): Water Taxi on-demand single AED 150/pax = $40.8; Dubai Ferry Gold AED 75 = $20.4, Silver AED 50 = $13.6; Water Bus AED 7; Abra AED 1. dubai-ferry.com / rta.ae 2025/26. Palm Jumeirah served by RTA Water Taxi + Dubai Ferry.
_fare_record.method: Premium per-seat = RTA Water Taxi single AED150=$40.8 + short-hop premium to Palm West marina. Grounded $40-95 band.

_demand_record.source: UAE-DEMAND-ANCHORS-2026-06-17.json — tier-based addressable pool derived from sourcing wave anchors (hotel keys × occ × shuttle adoption, marina activity, RTA marine baseline).
_demand_record.method: Dubai Harbour↔Palm Marina West feeder. ~12,000 Palm hotel keys × 78% occ × 365 → 3.4M room-nights; Marina-to-Palm transfer boat capture 1% = 34k oneway/yr. Anchor pool addressable (LB-103).
